notes.title: Electric Bench - Unreal Engine 5 Benchmark - Update 5.5.4D
notes.content: [p]Update 5.5.4D[/p][p][b]Improved RT performance[/b][/p][list][*][p]Up to 20% FPS improvement on RT Medium without any quality loss.[/p][/*][*][p]Up to 15% FPS improvement on RT High with same graphics settings and quality.[/p][/*][/list][p][b]New Features[/b][/p][list][*][p]Loop mode included[/p][/*][*][p]6 Upscale quality modes (Ultra performance, Performance, Balanced, Quality, Ultra Quality, Native)[/p][/*][*][p]Updated DLSS and FSR Plugin[/p][/*][/list][p]Not using Unreal 5.6.1 since still a lot of quality degradation with much more noise and scintilation, for just a few FPS gain.[/p][p]FSR4 Plugin still worse than using FSR 3.1.5 + Optiscaler, so still native FSR 3.1.5 for now.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45613808/2751d20ebeda8d7a0f24a3f37cb00a1d50d2f40d.jpg"][/img][/p]

tags.balance_change: - Up to 20% FPS improvement on RT Medium without any quality loss.
- Up to 15% FPS improvement on RT High with same graphics settings and quality.

tags.feature: - 6 Upscale quality modes (Ultra performance, Performance, Balanced, Quality, Ultra Quality, Native)
